LanguageData.SGQ_DescriptionTotal: The quota is the total number of each item allowed across this entire vanilla storage group. Excess is hauled outside the group.
LanguageData.SGQ_DescriptionSimilar: Set a maximum amount per stack and a maximum number of stacks for each item. Both values inherit independently through the category tree; total capacity = per-stack quota × max stacks.
LanguageData.SGQ_TotalQuotaTooltip: Maximum total quantity of each item type in this storage group.
LanguageData.SGQ_PerStackQuotaTooltip: Maximum quantity in each physical stack of an item type. A value of 0 uses that item's native stack limit.
LanguageData.SGQ_MaxStacksTooltip: Maximum physical stacks kept for each item type. This is an upper bound, not a target.
LanguageData.SGQ_RebalanceStatus: Stacks waiting to be split or merged: {0}
LanguageData.SGQ_NoOverflow: No overflow in this storage group.
LanguageData.SGQ_ZeroHelpTotal: 0 means unlimited. Items inherit the nearest configured category, then the global default.
LanguageData.SGQ_ZeroHelpSimilar: 0 per stack uses the native limit; max stacks is at least 1. The two values inherit independently.
LanguageData.SGQ_InheritedFieldTooltip: Inherited value: {0}. Source: {1}. Click to create an override for this field.
LanguageData.SGQ_CategoryQuotaTooltip: A category value is inherited separately by each descendant item; it is not one shared total for the category.
LanguageData.SGQ_CategoryTotalTooltip: A category quota is inherited separately by each descendant item; it is not one shared total for the category.
LanguageData.SGQ_CategorySimilarTooltip: Per-stack and max-stack values are inherited separately by each descendant item; the category does not share one quantity or stack pool.
LanguageData.SGQ_RemoveFieldOverrideTooltip: Remove the {0} override. It will use {1}, inherited from {2}.
LanguageData.SGQ_RetainedDisallowedItem: This item is no longer allowed by the vanilla storage filter. It remains listed because it has a quota or max-stack override, or is still stored in this group.
